title: Distordia Content Verification Standard (v0.2.0 unified anchor draft)
description: Successor draft to content.v0.1.0. One provenance ANCHOR covering both external and native Distordia content. The body lives off-chain on a decentralized store (Arweave/IPFS, addressed by 'cid'); the on-chain asset anchors 'cid + hash + phash + C2PA + author-namespace + AI-disclosure'. Social posts and Articles become typed views over this anchor (kind=post|article|media|external). See docs/content-cluster-design-note.md.
maxSize: 1KB (system fields ~180 bytes). Most string fields are immutable and store actual length; a typical record (one of uri/cid set, threading/claim-review empty) sits well under 1KB. Keep 'title'/'uri' concise to stay clear of the worst case.

self-addr.description: Queryable copy of this asset's own register address (the auto-assigned 'address' is not filterable in register/list). Stamped post-create; links resolve via 'WHERE self-addr = <value>'.

kind.description: What this anchor describes. Lets one standard cover all content types.

author.description: Author NAMESPACE (attestable via the namespace standard), not a free-text name or genesis hash.

uri.description: Location of the body. https URL (external), or ar://<txid> / ipfs://<cid> for native content. Mutable so a gateway URL can be repointed; integrity is fixed by 'hash'/'cid'.

cid.description: Content-addressed identifier of the body (IPFS CID or Arweave tx id). Immutable; survives link rot. Present for native content stored off-chain on a decentralized store.

hash.description: SHA-256 hard binding of the body (format 'sha256:...'). Detects tampering.

phash.description: Perceptual/soft hash for media (survives transcoding, unlike the exact hash). Empty for text.

c2pa.description: Hash or address of a C2PA (Content Credentials) manifest, when present. Anchors the industry provenance standard rather than reinventing it.

ai-disclosure.description: AI involvement in producing the content.

reply-to.description: self-addr of the content/post being replied to (threading).

quote.description: self-addr of the content/post being quoted.

claim-review.description: self-addr of a fact-check (ClaimReview) asset rating this content. The chain anchors who-said-what; the verdict is asserted by the reviewer.

supersedes.description: self-addr of the prior version this content supersedes (append-only revision).

examples._comment: A long-form article: body on Arweave, anchored on-chain.
examples.title: The Future of Agent-to-Agent Commerce
examples.author: distordia-labs

notes: Body off-chain on a DECENTRALIZED store (Arweave permanent / IPFS) -- off-chain is not centralized. On-chain anchors cid+hash; integrity is verifiable by anyone.
Social posts and Articles are typed views: a post is kind=post (short body may be inline in the social asset), an article is kind=article with body off-chain via cid.
Covers the v0.1.0 gap where native Distordia content (articles, posts) could not be verified by the content standard.
claim-review is a future companion asset type (schema.org ClaimReview analog).
Successor draft to content.v0.1.0 (standards/content-standard.json), retained for history.
